question_en: List the sections referenced by section 5.4.4 of spec 38.321 (outgoing references).
original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'5.4.4'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(ref:Section) RETURN ref.sectionId, ref.sectionTitle ORDER BY ref.sectionId
reference_query:
MATCH (anchor:Section {sectionNumber: '5.4.4'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.321'})
MATCH (anchor)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(ref:Section)
RETURN DISTINCT ref.sectionId AS sectionId
